name: judgment
description: Plugins from the judgment crate: tools for typed, calibrated judgments from System One models.

plugins.name: jud
plugins.description: Write, review, fix, run, measure, bias-test and tune .jud documents (Rubric, Cases, Recording), images and Box questions included, hold them in CI, serve them over MCP, and turn a rubric into a typed Rust module, with the judgment crate's reader and jud command: the jud, jud-tune and jud-rust skills, two hooks, and the /jud:rubric, /jud:cases, /jud:check, /jud:review, /jud:run, /jud:record, /jud:eval, /jud:tune, /jud:bias, /jud:compare, /jud:ci, /jud:serve and /jud:rust commands.

plugins.name: judgment
plugins.description: Use the judgment crate from Rust: typed questions and calibrated answers with its guarantees intact, tests with no key and no network, and observed, paced calls: the judgment, judgment-test and judgment-observe skills and the /judgment:integrate, /judgment:test and /judgment:observe commands.
